contexts.text: By inducing bodies on them.
Pains induced by resistance.
To induce [the belief] that they were others.
Horror is induced for these things.
Temptations are means... of inducing goods and truths.
The diabolical crew, which leads into temptation.
Wakefulness induced on the senses...
The states the Spirits were inducing (on me).
Lead us not into temptation. It is according to the sense of the letter that He leads into temptation; but the internal sense is that He leads no one into it.
It is the evils and falsities with man which lead him into temptation; consequently the evil Spirits and Genii who infuse them.
The Lord permits the infernals in the other life to lead the good into temptation...
Thus dulness is induced... by the magicians there... They also know how to induce fallacies...
The magicians there... induce on others changes of states...
The pillar induced darkness on the Egyptians...
These things are what induce what is sad and anxious on minds, and thence on faces. AC 8250.
They who trust in themselves, continually induce evil on themselves...
They concluded that knowledges induce a shade...
Man is to be led into order by Knowledges...
(These Spirits) induce anxieties...
By gains and honours... they were induced to love themselves and the world.
It is not allowable (there) to induce on one's self faces contrary to the love.
That they might be brought into some angelic Society.
They had induced the vulgar to believe...
He leads himself into Hell... The Lord is so far from leading man into Hell...
The like may be inferred from...
They induced darkness.
They induce matters on them.
Under Lead, see these references. DP 296:3.
Holiness induced on it by authority.
They who induce obscurities...
Lead us not into temptation. Explained.
They can induce others to believe...
Spirits do not tolerate others inducing anything...
Persuasion... can thus induce...
Some induce on themselves to reason...
Which induce Falsities.
That natures are induced through external things.
They try to induce a bond of conscience...
On those who induce the persons of others.
As hypocrites induce pains on the teeth, so other Spirits induce other pains...
On Spirits who induce diseases.
The Arians induce a pain on the right arm near the shoulder blade. The Socinians induce a pain on the breast-bone.
